pages.title: Hum
pages.text:
**Spark.** Strike a Drumheart before you touch a wire. Spirit Pulse is the power fantasy here; Powah and Mekanism are bridges you cross later, if you want.\
Bone Chime, Spirit Shard, Copper Resonator, Drumheart. Then listen.

pages.title: Before you move on
pages.text:
**Goal:** finish Spark and seat the Spark token.\
You need a **Drumheart** and the first Pulse trickle from Start here.\
**Check:** Finish Spark. Claim the token and seat it. The Spark notch lights.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Read **Start here** for worked examples. Recipes live in JEI; the **Spirit Codex** covers Tribal Power machinery. If you get stuck, test one recipe at a time and sneak-use the Spirit Codex on a silent machine.
